newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for June 19.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for June 19.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open on Thursday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1500 local/2000 GMT daily meteorological report.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Pacific Coast, Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean.

Clear skies and warm temperatures with maximum winds 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 16 miles per hour) and waves three to five feet high. Possible light rains along coasts of Michoacan, Nayarit, Jalisco, Colima, Guerrero, Oaxaca and Chiapas.
Cloudy with some rains and wind gusts. Winds from 10 to 15 knots and waves three to five feet high.
Possible rains in Quintana Roo and regional winds about 10 to 15 knots.
Light rains along Nicaragua, Panama and Costa Rica.
